claimReviews.text: NeuroCalm proves a 42% reduction in relapse and is superior to standard CBT triage for adolescent anxiety.
No adverse events occurred in the deployment cohort of n=812 participants.
The AI triage workflow eliminated waitlist inequity across rural clinics.
The intervention is ready for national deployment across adolescents.
fMRI activation patterns suggest the intervention may improve emotion regulation.
